lines.text: The faithful city once full of justice now holds only murderers, and its rulers love bribes.
The city's silver has become dross, and its fine wine is diluted with oil.
The Lord will purge the dross, restore the judges as at first, and call the city the Faithful City.
Zion will be redeemed with justice, her priests with righteousness, but rebels and sinners will be shattered together.
The people will be ashamed of the sacred oaks, and the strong man and his work will burn with no one to quench the flames.
